data.description: Spacious | Creek and Canal View | Prime Location
data.display_address: Tower D, DAMAC Towers by Paramount, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident is thrilled to present this amazing one-bedroom apartment at DAMAC Towers by Paramount, a masterpiece of luxury living inspired by Hollywood glamour. This fully furnished residence offers a spacious and elegantly designed layout, complete with premium finishes and modern touches that elevate your living experience.

The apartment includes a generously sized bedroom, two contemporary bathrooms, and a separate laundry room, ensuring maximum comfort and convenience. Floor to ceiling windows provide abundant natural light and showcase stunning open Creek and Canal views, adding an unmatched sense of serenity to your daily lifestyle.

Situated in the vibrant heart of Business Bay, this property enjoys a truly strategic location just 10 minutes from Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and the iconic Burj Khalifa. The towers are exceptionally well serviced, offering world-class hospitality, impressive facilities, and an energetic environment ideal for both residents and investors.

Features:

Fully furnished one-bedroom apartment
Two modern bathrooms
Separate laundry room
Open Creek and Canal views
High-end interiors inspired by Paramount Hotels & Resorts
Spacious and thoughtfully designed layout
Covered parking
Supermarket within the towers

Amenities:

Multiple swimming pools, including a rooftop infinity pool
Fully equipped fitness center
Luxury spa facilities
Private cinema
Kids' play area
24-hour security
24-hour valet parking service
Restaurants and shops within the complex
Located in the prime area of Business Bay
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
10 minutes from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa
Tenanted until February 2026.
